record.field: A quotation: Sales > Quotations, then Print > Estimate
Prices offered to a customer, valid 7 days

ol.li: Prices quoted are valid for 7 days from date of issue, unless otherwise stated.
Prices are exclusive of VAT unless indicated.
Delivery timelines are subject to stock availability and confirmation at the time of order.
Delivery within the environs of Nairobi is offered at zero charge however, the order must be Kshs ten thousand (Kshs 10,000/-) and above.
{company} reserves the right to amend prices due to raw material fluctuations, exchange rate movements, or regulatory changes.
All transactions are subject to the laws of Kenya.
Disputes, if any, shall be referred to arbitration in Nairobi under the Arbitration Act.
Company reserves the right to amend terms with prior notice.
{company} shall not be held liable for delays caused by natural disasters, strikes, government actions, or other circumstances beyond its control.

record.field: A quotation or sales order: Print > Pro Forma Invoice
An advance payment request, not a tax invoice

ol.li: Prices quoted are valid for 7 days from date of issue, unless otherwise stated.
This is not a tax invoice; it is an advance payment request.
Goods will only be dispatched upon receipt of cleared funds unless credit terms are agreed in writing.
Prices provided are ex-factory prices. Bank charges, transport costs, logistics, import duties, and applicable taxes are payable by the buyer.
Orders once confirmed are non-cancellable, except with written approval from {company}.
Delivery timelines are subject to stock availability and confirmation at the time of order.
Delivery within the environs of Nairobi is offered at zero charge however, the order must be Kshs ten thousand (Kshs 10,000/-) and above.
{company} reserves the right to amend prices due to raw material fluctuations, exchange rate movements, or regulatory changes.
All transactions are subject to the laws of Kenya.
Disputes, if any, shall be referred to arbitration in Nairobi under the Arbitration Act.
Company reserves the right to amend terms with prior notice.
{company} shall not be held liable for delays caused by natural disasters, strikes, government actions, or other circumstances beyond its control.

record.field: An invoice: Invoicing > Customers > Invoices, then Print, or Send
The tax invoice for goods sold in Kenya

ol.li: Terms of payment due on date indicated on invoice.
{company} will only accept return of goods for exchange or replacement, if returned within 48hrs of invoice.
Replacement (only applicable) if damaged; exchange only allowed for unopened bottles, jerrycans and cartons.
Title to goods remains with {company} until full payment is received.
Risk passes to the buyer upon delivery/collection.
Any/all disputes must be raised in writing within 48 hours of invoice date.

record.field: A paid invoice: Print > Sales Receipt
Proof of payment, with the items and how they were paid

ol.li: Goods once sold are non-returnable unless defective.
Customer is advised to check goods upon collection/delivery. Claims must be made within 24 hours.

record.field: A credit note: Invoicing > Customers > Credit Notes, then Print
Against a verified overpayment, return or adjustment

ol.li: Issued strictly against verified overpayment, return, or adjustment.
Valid for offset against future purchases only; no cash refunds.

record.field: A delivery: Inventory > Deliveries, then Print > Delivery Note
Goods going to a customer, signed for on arrival

ol.li: Packing details are provided for verification purposes only.
Buyer is responsible for checking quantities upon delivery.
Any discrepancies must be reported within 24 hours.

field.name: acknowledgement
field.p: This is to confirm that the items as per the packing list have been received in good and acceptable conditions. We are authorised to accept goods on behalf of the buyer.

record.field: A customer return: Return on the delivery, then Print > Goods Replacement Note
Defective or wrongly supplied goods a customer returns for replacement

ol.li: Replacement goods are issued only for items proven to be defective, or wrongly supplied.
Goods must be returned unused, in original packaging, within 48 hours.
{company} reserves the right to reject claims arising from misuse, poor storage, or third-party tampering.

record.field: An invoice to a customer abroad: Print > Commercial Invoice
The export invoice: both currencies and the rate, HS codes, KEBS permits, weights

ol.li: Buyer responsible for all import duties, taxes, clearing, and customs formalities at destination.
Delivery terms are Ex-Factory only.
{company} guarantees products meet KEBS/ISO/GMP standards at time of shipment.
No liability accepted for delays caused by any logistics, customs, port authorities, shipping lines, or force majeure.
Payment must be effected via Telegraphic Transfer as agreed, net of all bank charges.

record.field: A delivery to a customer abroad: Print > Export Packing List
What customs inspect: cartons, pallets, net and gross weights

ol.li: Prepared for customs and verification purposes only.
Actual contents are subject to inspection by customs authorities.
{company} will not be liable for any delays, penalties, or rejections imposed by authorities due to buyer's incorrect documentation or non-compliance.

record.field: An RFQ: Purchase > Requests for Quotation, then Print RFQ
An invitation to suppliers to quote

ol.li: Status: This RFQ is an invitation to quote and does not bind {company} to purchase.
Response: All quotations must be in writing, valid for 30 days, and clearly state delivery timelines and payment terms.
Evaluation: {company} reserves the right to accept or reject any quotation, in whole or in part, without obligation to the bidder.
Confidentiality: Information shared in the RFQ process is confidential and may not be disclosed without written consent from {company}.

record.field: A confirmed order: Purchase > Purchase Orders, then Print > Purchase Order
The order a supplier delivers against

ol.li: Contract: A PO issued by {company} constitutes a binding contract once accepted by the supplier.
Terms: Supplies must strictly comply with the quantities, specifications, quality standards, and delivery dates stated in the PO.
Rejection: {company} reserves the right to reject goods or services that do not conform to specifications.
Payment: Payment terms are as specified in the PO; invoices must quote the PO number for processing.
Compliance: Suppliers must comply with all applicable laws, KEBS standards, and regulatory requirements.

record.field: A receipt: Inventory > Receipts, then Print > Goods Received Note
Goods received from a supplier, subject to inspection

ol.li: Confirmation: The GRN confirms receipt of goods but is subject to inspection and quality checks.
No Waiver: Signing a GRN does not constitute acceptance of defective, damaged, or non-compliant goods.
Claims: {company} reserves the right to reject or return goods found unsatisfactory after inspection.
Liability: The supplier remains liable for replacement or corrective action at their own cost.

record.field: A return to a supplier: Return on the receipt, then Print > Goods Return Note
Defective, damaged, surplus or non-conforming goods sent back

ol.li: Reason: Issued when goods are defective, damaged, surplus, or non-conforming to order specifications.
Responsibility: Supplier bears full responsibility for collection, replacement, or credit of returned goods.
Condition: Goods must be uplifted within 7 working days of notification; failure to do so may result in disposal at supplier's cost.

record.field: An internal transfer: Inventory > Operations > Transfers, then Print > Transfer Form
Goods moving between warehouses, branches or departments

ol.li: Transfers must be pre-approved by the responsible manager or HOD.
Both sending and receiving parties must sign and date the form.
All transfers must be entered into the stock system within 24 hours.
Unauthorized transfers will be treated as stock loss or misconduct.

record.field: Physical Inventory: select the lines to count, then Print > Stock Count Sheet
System quantity, counted quantity and variance, signed by the count team

ol.li: Physical count must be conducted by at least two staff members (checker + verifier).
Sheets must be signed by warehouse officer and finance representative.
Variances must be documented and explained within 48 hours.
Stock sheets form part of audit records and must be archived.

record.field: Written here: New, then Issue once authorised
Instructions, policy changes, meeting notices, staff reminders

ol.li: All memos must be authorized by Management.
Staff must acknowledge receipt where required.
Memos are official records and must not be altered.
Non-compliance with instructions in memos may result in disciplinary action.

record.field: A purchase request: Purchase > Purchase Requests, then Print > Requisition Form
A department asks stores or finance for materials, inputs or services

ol.li: All requisitions must be approved by department head before submission.
Finance must confirm budget availability before procurement.
Stores may only release items against an approved requisition.
Misuse of requisition forms will result in disciplinary action.
